title: Sign in
pinInvalid: That first name and PIN don't match. After 5 wrong tries the PIN locks.
pinLocked: This PIN is locked after too many tries. Ask a manager for a new one.
ambiguous: Two people here have this first name and PIN. Ask a manager to give one of them a new PIN.
noStaff: Nobody has a PIN for this location yet. A manager sets them under Staff.
shiftNote: You stay signed in on this device for one shift (12 hours). The app opens where your role works.
restaurantHint: A new device first asks which restaurant it is for. Type the restaurant's address, or paste the sign-in link a manager finds under Staff.
restaurantUnknown: We don't know this restaurant. Check the address, or ask a manager for the sign-in link.
resetHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app and choose a new password.
resetInvalid: That did not work. Check your email and code.
